devices.title: Accton-manufactured Facebook Wedge 100
facts: Historical first-party article dated 2016-10-18. Explicit Accton manufacturer claims for the two printed model names. Facebook production deployment applies to Wedge 100; the commercial Wedge 100-32X has documented design lineage only. No individual-unit provenance, present stock, support, firmware availability or current ownership is established. Namespace and whitespace variants remain separate; no cross-brand or suffix aliases are inferred.
Accton is the named manufacturer, not an asserted retail brand.
Facebook names Accton Technology as manufacturer of Wedge 100 for its network.
2016 design: 19-inch chassis; Facebook describes a separate 21-inch Open Rack adapter.
Facebook describes an optional pass-through module connecting the Open Rack 12V bus to the switch board; installed auction hardware must be checked.
hyperscaler: Facebook reported production use of Wedge 100 in its data centers on 2016-10-18; no surplus-unit provenance.
